title: 第11章 日本好啊
content_zh:
把剧本给了范小胖之后，就没有了动静。

    谷川也默认她已经同意参演女主了，让她这段时间多增肥。

    她要扮演的是底层女性，不能那么好看，要丑一点。

    范小胖对谷川也十分无语。

    我还没答应要出演呢，你就把我安排上了？

    谷川则是和田庄庄约好了时间，来见个面。

    谷川对田庄庄非常感兴趣。

    不是因为他是北电的老师，也不是因为他爹是北影厂首任厂长，而是因为他因为《蓝风筝》喜提十年禁导。

    《蓝风筝》这个电影相当有意思。

    有日本投资，拍摄国内的敏感、伤痕题材，后期在日本制作，还获得了东京电影节的奖。

    电影拍出来的目的是什么，这都没法说。

    可能田庄庄没那个心思，但恶劣影响反正已经造成了。

    其实六代那些地下导演，很多就是这样的，拿着国外的投资，拍国内的阴暗面，然后去国外得奖拿奖金，接着回来继续拍电影。

    国内禁止这些电影出国参加评奖，但人家也有办法，偷偷的去，甚至有人顶着日本电影的名号去参展。

    对他们只是禁导，都算轻的了。

    但谷川来找田庄庄，可不是愤世嫉俗的喷人的。

    他看到田庄庄，泪花就开始在眼珠子里面打转。

    田庄庄都蒙了。

    虽然两人在电话里聊的挺好的，但见面的时候，田庄庄还是很生疏的。

    可看到谷川都快哭出来了，田庄庄还是懵逼的进行安慰。

    谷川擦了擦眼角，带着泪腔说道：“回到国内，才知道国内电影有多难拍。”

    “怎么回事？”

    “我写了个剧本，给投资人看了看，他们说这电影可能过不了审，没办法上映，都不愿意投资。”

    谷川说道：“我给南加州大学的师兄看过了，他们都说这剧本不错，是能拿奖的那种。”

    谷川掏出剧本，递给田庄庄。

    田庄庄还稀里糊涂的呢，手上就多了一个剧本。

    他打开看了看。

    写的是一个从监狱里出来的男人，遭遇到的黑恶势力的威胁，生活的压迫和政付的不作为，甚至助纣为虐。

    电影的基调相当黑暗。

    田庄庄看着，故事讲的不错，主角的心路历程和社会氛围，都描绘得不错。

    如果能拍出来的话，是一部不错的电影。

    “这可以拍啊。”田庄庄说道。
content_en:
After giving the script to Fan Xiaopang, there was no movement.

    Tanigawa also acquiesced that she had agreed to participate in the female lead role, allowing her to gain more weight during this time.

    She wants to play a lower-class woman, not so good-looking, but a little ugly.

    Fan Xiaopang was also speechless towards Gu Chuan.

    I haven't even agreed to appear, and you've arranged for me to appear?

    Tanichuan made an appointment with Tianzhuangzhuang to meet.

    Tanichuan is very interested in Gianzhuangzhuang.

    Not because he was a teacher at Nortel, nor because his father was the first director of Beijing Film Studio, but because he was banned from directing for ten years because of "Blue Kite".

    The movie "Blue Kite" is quite interesting.

    With Japanese investment, it filmed domestic sensitive and scar-related themes and was later produced in Japan. It also won an award at the Tokyo Film Festival.

    It’s hard to say what the purpose of the movie was.

    Maybe Gianzhuangzhuang didn't have that intention, but the bad impact was already caused anyway.

    In fact, many of the underground directors of the sixth generation were like this. They used foreign investment to film the dark side of the country, then went abroad to win awards and bonuses, and then came back to continue making movies.

    Domestically, these films are prohibited from traveling abroad to participate in awards competitions, but there are ways to go secretly, and some people even go to exhibitions under the name of Japanese films.

    Just banning them from being guided is considered a light thing.

    But Tanigawa came to Gianzhuangzhuang not as a cynical troll.

    When he saw Gianzhuang Village, tears began to well up in his eyes.

    Grange and village are all confused.

    Although the two had a good chat on the phone, Gianzhuangzhuang was still very unfamiliar when they met.

    But seeing Tanichuan almost crying, Tianzhuangzhuang still comforted him in a daze.

    Tanichuan wiped the corners of his eyes and said with tears in his eyes: "When I returned to China, I realized how difficult it is to make domestic movies."

    "What's going on?"

    "I wrote a script and showed it to investors. They said that the film might not pass the review and be released, so they were unwilling to invest."

    Tanigawa said: "I showed it to my senior fellows at the University of Southern California, and they all said the script was good and could win awards."

    Tanichuan took out the script and handed it to Tian Zhuangzhuang.

    Gianzhuangzhuang is still confused, but he has an extra script in hand.

    He opened it and looked at it.

    It writes about a man who came out of prison and encountered the threats of evil forces, the oppression of life and the inaction of the government, and even aided the evil forces.

    The tone of the movie is quite dark.

    Gianzhuangzhuang looked at it and found that the story was well told, and the protagonist's mental journey and social atmosphere were well depicted.

    It would be a good movie if it could be made.

    "This can be filmed." Tian Zhuangzhuang said.
